name: When is the best time to install or replace trim during a home renovation?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to install or replace trim during a home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal time to install or replace trim is typically after major construction, drywall installation, and painting of the walls, but before the final flooring is laid down. This sequence ensures that the trim can be cut and fitted precisely against finished walls and prevents paint splatters on new flooring. If flooring is already installed, protective measures will be taken. For new installations, allowing the trim to acclimate to your home's humidity for a few days before installation can help prevent future warping or gaps.
acceptedAnswer.description: Install or replace trim after drywall and wall painting, but ideally before final flooring, to ensure precision and prevent damage.
